acceptanceCriteria: Each Ruby language frontier carries the path (and line where known) of the construct that raised it.
A Rails fixture change whose reach does not cross any located frontier returns scope BOUNDED with its tier-1 selection; a change that does cross one stays UNKNOWN naming that frontier.
The issue's acceptance tests are met, so the PR can carry Closes #1519.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1519. In a Rails app with about 3,100 RSpec files, corvint affected --path FILE returns scope UNKNOWN for every changed file, with the same five LANGUAGE_FRONTIER entries (ruby:ambiguous-test-framework, conditional-load, dynamic-load, dynamic-test-definition, rails-autoload) and no path or line. Tier-1 selections are right, but the scope is never BOUNDED, so fail-closed callers always run the full suite. Expected: frontiers are located (path and line) and only count against a change whose reach actually crosses them. Actual: they are repository-wide.
